L72: cite32†Image L73: ## About KRONOS EUROPE
L74: 
L75: KRONOS EUROPE, located in Langerbrugge, near Ghent, Belgium, has been an established name in the port of Ghent for more than 65 years. Since November 1957, titanium dioxide has been produced there. In the early years the production was based on the sulfate process. In 1989 a new plant was built and since then manufacturing has been based on the chloride process.
L76: KRONOS EUROPE has ambitious plans. One of the latest major projects was the installation of a state-of-the-art packaging line. In the coming years, the focus will be on energy transition. Numerous initiatives are in the pipeline to ensure that we can continue to produce (at least) 90,000 tons of titanium dioxide per year in a sustainable way.
L77: 
L78: cite33†Image L79: ## Unique location near the Port of Ghent
L80: Ores (e.g., rutile) are the main raw material for the manufacturing of titanium dioxide. These are shipped in by seagoing vessels from different parts of the world such as South Africa, Australia, and Sierra-Leone. Due to its unique location in the port, KRONOS EUROPE not only has easy access to those raw materials, but the plant is also ideally located to supply our other production sites, worldwide. Our location in the port of Ghent is also favorable for energy transition.
L81: Take, for example, the initiatives concerning the production and supply of hydrogen, the capture and transport of CO_{2} and the expansion of the high-voltage network that is necessary for sustainable electrification. The port and other local industry plays an important coordinating and supporting role in this. The proximity of quality educational institutions, colleges and Ghent University is also an asset of our location in the port of Ghent.
L82: This way, we can ensure of a constant supply of knowledge and talent.
L83: cite34†Image L84: ## TiOCl_{2} for the cosmetics industry
L85: 
L86: At KRONOS EUROPE, in parallel with titanium dioxide (TiO_{2}), titanium oxychloride (TiOCl_{2}) is also produced. KRONOS EUROPE, is one of the few producers of this niche product. Titanium oxychloride is a transparent liquid used, among others, for the manufacturing of pearlescent pigments. You can find these pigments in cosmetics.
L87: ## A career with us
L88: 
L89: Welcome to the career section of KRONOS EUROPE. We appreciate your interest and hope to welcome you soon. At KRONOS EUROPE, we strive to build a culture of mutual respect and understanding of differences. We are committed to creating and maintaining a workplace in which employees are valued for their skills, experience, and unique perspectives.

L93: cite36†Image L94: ## Brighter together
L95: 
L96: Brighter together is much more than just our claim. These two words are the heart of our global culture. This is how we add value and interact with each other and our customers. We are ONE KRONOS, an initiative that highlights the breadth of our culture across the globe, aligned around our corporate values. Brighter together is our compass in everything we do and gives direction to all our initiatives and projects.

L100: cite37†Image L101: ## Localized Benefits
L102: 
L103: At KRONOS EUROPE, we offer more than competitive salaries. Our employees benefit from a healthy work-life balance, with at least 38 days of leave annually, and no mandatory collective closure. We also provide a flexible cafeteria plan that allows you to purchase ICT equipment, lease a bicycle, or even an electric car. These benefits reflect our commitment to valuing our employees and making KRONOS EUROPE an excellent place to work.

L108: We offer training, leadership development, and a community spirit to empower our employees to utilize their knowledge and experience as they grow with us. As an organization, we recognize that the time is now to identify, train, and grow the future leaders of KRONOS.
